description: A warmly organic dining room with a rustic English or Provencal country sensibility. The walls are finished in a warm sandy beige plaster with subtle undulating texture suggesting a hand-applied surface. A large multi-pane window on the left wall fills the room with abundant soft daylight filtered through natural linen curtain panels in warm oatmeal, and the view beyond shows lush green garden foliage. A generous dining table in heavily grained, rustic reclaimed-style wood with a pale bleached honey finish is set for a casual meal with slate-grey linen placemats, simple white ceramic plates, and amber-tinted drinking glasses — two filled, one set decoratively. A woven bread basket holds a rustic loaf. Solid wood dining chairs in natural light oak surround the table. Along the back wall, a wide sideboard or buffet in rough-hewn medium-toned wood holds a collection of terracotta and earthenware pots and vessels in various heights, along with dried branch arrangements creating organic vertical interest. A soft pool of warm light falls on the table surface from an object suspended above — its form is roughly dome-shaped in a pale sandy textured material with a dark contrasting band, emanating warm light downward across the tabletop. The palette is entirely earthy: sandy beige plaster, bleached wood, terracotta, amber glass, warm linen, and deep garden green through the window. Camera at approximately standing eye-level, using a normal lens with a three-quarter view capturing the full table, chairs, sideboard, and window in a single cohesive room shot. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
